privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Wizer Signage collects, uses, and protects information when you use our website and platform.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect account details you provide (such as name, company, email, and phone) and usage data needed to operate the service.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use your information to provide and improve the service, manage your account, communicate with you, and ensure security.

sections.heading: Data storage & security
sections.body: Data is stored securely and access is restricted. Passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your data. We share information only with service providers needed to run the platform, or where required by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions, contact us at hello@wizer.sa.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your access to and use of the Wizer Signage website and platform.

sections.heading: Using the service
sections.body: You agree to use the service lawfully and not to misuse, disrupt, or attempt to gain unauthorized access to it.

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for your account, the security of your credentials, and the activity of users you invite.

sections.heading: Trials & billing
sections.body: Free trials run for the stated period. Paid plans are billed per the plan you select; you may change or cancel anytime.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: You retain ownership of content you upload and are responsible for having the rights to display it.

sections.heading: Availability
